name: The Grimm Prospects of an Office Worker
source:
You're a Data Entry Specialist for Grimm Corp. 

Sure.

It holds none of the glitz and glamour that was promised after Death and you've never legally held a scythe before, but hey!

You're making it work for you.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251009070238/https://unknown-hermit.itch.io/the-grimm-prospects-of-an-office-worker]itch.io[/url]]
